APPLICATION TIER — RENDER WEB SERVICE · UVICORN + FASTAPI · SINGLE INSTANCE, 512 MB, PYTHON 3.12
OAuth2 password flow → HS256 JWT (8 h)
Passwords & AI key: env vars only
The queue is the database: a status column (queued → running → done | failed). The in-process Queue only wakes the worker.
ONE worker thread, deliberately sequential — peak ≈ 200 MB for a 100 k-row workbook against a 512 MB cap.
Atomic claim: UPDATE … WHERE status='queued' — first writer wins, so duplicate workers or re-queues cannot double-run a job.
Progress written at most every 2 s; a live in-memory dict feeds the admin “currently running” panel without a query.
Crash/restart recovery: queued + running rows are re-queued on startup (inputs are retained in the row until completion).
Guard rails: max 3 unfinished jobs per user (429) · inputs cleared on finish · results gzipped · 30-day retention sweep.
Request handlers call these through run_in_threadpool, so blocking DB work never stalls the event loop.
VALIDATION ENGINE — validator/ PACKAGE · PURE PYTHON, NO I/O BEYOND THE WORKBOOKS · SHARED BY THE FASTAPI BACKEND AND THE STREAMLIT APP (app.py)
